m: निघानिघ mfn. of different forms or sizes, W.

suppression or absence of accent, AV.; Prāt.
a: निघातः — 1 A blow, stroke; R. 11. 78. --2 Suppression or absence of accent. --3 A vowel having a grave accent.

m: नि-घातम् ind. having struck, MW.

m: नि-घा˚ति f. an iron club or hammer, L.
नि-घा˚तिन् mfn. striking down, killing, destroying (ifc.), MBh.; Hariv.

v: pu॰ nirviSezaRa hanyate hana--ka ni॰ । samavistAraderDye tulyArohapariRAhe padArTe amaraH । niGA niGatarucCannEH” BawwiH “niGo nimitam” pA॰ nimitamiha samArohapariRAhAByAM mitaM nimitamityucyate” jayama॰ ।
m: नि-घ mfn. (√ हन्) as high as broad (= विष्वक्-सम), L.
(?) equally distant (as trees), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 87, Kāś.
नि-घ m. anything whose height and circumference are equal (as a circle a ball &c.), W.
sin (cf. अ-घ), L.
नि-घ m. (also) a pointed instrument for boring holes in jewels &c., L.
a: निघ — a. As high as broad. --घः 1 A ball. --2 Sin.

k.v: आविधो विध्यते येन तत्र विष्वक्समे निघः। उत्कारश्च निकारश्च द्वौ धान्योत्क्षेपणार्थकौ॥

a: निघंटुः — 1 A vocabulary or glossary of words. --2 Particularly the glossary of Vedic words explained by Yāska in his Nirukta.

m: नि-घण्ट m. (√ घण्ट्, to speak?; cf. घण्टा, a bell) a collection of words, vocabulary, Cat.
N. of a Dānava, Kathās.
नि-घण्˚टि m. a glossary, Cat.
नि-घण्˚टिका f. a species of bulbous plant, L.

s: puM, (niGaRwati SoBate iti । GaRwadIptO + “mfgayvAdayaSca .” uRAM । 1 । 38 । iti kupratyayena sADuH .) nAmasaMgrahaH । iti hemacandraH । 2 । 172 ॥
v: pu॰ ni + Gawi--u । paryyAyanAmrAmekatrArTakaTanAya saMgrahe kozABiDAnAdO tacca fgvedaBAzyopakrame uktaM yaTA “AdyaM nEGaRWukaM kARqaM dvitIyaM nEgamaM taTA” asyArTaH ekArTavAcinAM paryyAyaSabdAnAM saNGo yatra prAyeRopadiSyate tatra niGaRwuSabdaH prasidDaH । tAdfSezvamarasiMhavEjayantIhalAyuDAdizu daSa niGaRwava iti vyavahArAt । evamatrApi paryyAyaSabdasaNGopadeSAdAdyakARqasya nEGaRwukatvam । tasmin kARqe trayo'DyAyAH । tezu praTame pfTivyAdilokadikkAlAdidravyavizayARi nAmAmi, dvitIye manuzyatadavayavAdidravyavizayARi, tftIye taduBayadravyagatatanubahutvahrasatvAdiDarmavizayARi” ।
m: नि-घण्˚टु m. a glossary (also -क), N. of sev. works.
(mostly pl.) N. of the Vedic glossary explained by Yāska in his Nirukta
नि-घण्˚टु—भाष्य n. N. of wk.
नि-घण्˚टु—खण्ड-निर्वचन n. N. of wk.
नि-घण्˚टु—शेष m. N. of wk.
नि-घण्˚टु—कोश m. N. of wk.
नि-घण्˚टु—राज m. N. of wk.
नि-घण्˚टु—सार m. N. of wk.
नि-घण्˚टु—संग्रह-निदान n. N. of wk.
नि-घण्˚टु—समय m. N. of wk.

v: pu॰ ni + Gfza--BAve GaY । zarzaRe (GasA) “taruSAKAnta niGarzajo'nalaH” kirA॰ । lyuw । niGarzaRamapyatra na॰ । yaTA hi kanakaM SudDaM tApacCedaniGarzaREH” BA॰ SA॰ 122 57 Slo॰ ।
m: नि-घर्ष ˚षण. See नि-घृष् below.
नि—˚घर्ष m. rubbing, pounding, crushing, Kāv.
v.l. for नि-कष, Mālav. ii, 7.
a: निघर्षः, निघर्षणं — 1 Rubbing, friction; Ki. 2. 51. --2 Grinding.

m: नि—˚घर्षण n. rubbing, grinding, trituration, MBh.

s: puM, (nyadanamiti । ni + ad BakzaRe + “nO Ra ca .” 3 । 3 । 60 । iti ap । “GaYapoSca .” 2 । 4 । 38 । iti GaslAdeSaH .) AhAraH । ityamaraH । 2 । 9 । 56 ॥
v: pu॰ ni + ada + ap GasAdeSaH । Bojane amaraH ।
m: नि-घस m. (√ घस्) eating, food, L.

k.v: जेमनं लेह आहारो निघासो न्याद इत्यपि। सौहित्यं तर्पणं तृप्तिः फेला भुक्तसमुज्झितम्.।

m: नि-√ 2. घृष् P. -घर्षति to rub into, rub down, grind, wear away, MBh.; to try, examine, ib.
a: निघृष् — {c1c} P. 1 To rub, pound, grind. --2 To graze, wear away by rubbing or grinding.

m: नि—˚घृष्व mfn. rubbed off, excoriated
worn away, harassed, afflicted, TaittĀr., Sch.
small, insignificant, Naigh.
नि—˚घृष्व m. a hoof, Uṇ. i, 153, Sch.
an ass, a mule or a boar, L.
नि—˚घृष्व n. the mark of a hoof, Uṇ.; ib.
a: निघृष्व — a. 1 Rubbed off, excoriated. --2 Small, trifling, insignificant. --ष्वः 1 A hoof. --2 Wind. --3 An ass or mule. --4 A boar. --5 A road. --ष्वं The mark of a hoof.

m: नि—˚घृष्ट mfn. rubbed, ground, worn away, subdued, MBh.
a: निघृष्ट — p. p. 1 Rubbed, ground. --2 Chafed, grazed. --3 Subdued, overpowered.

s: tri, (nihanyate nigfhyate iti । ni + hana + GaYarTe kaH । niyamyatvAdevAsya taTAtvam .) aDInaH । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 16 ॥ (yaTA, raGuvaMSe । 14 । 58 । “ASvAsya rAmAvarajaH satIM tAmAKyAtavAlmIkiniketamArgaH । niGnasya me BarttfnideSarOkzyaM devi ! kzamasveti baBUva namraH ॥”) aNkapUraRam । iti lIlAvatI ॥ (yaTA, sUryyasidDAnte । 3 । 29 । “punardbAdaSaniGnAcca laByate yat PalaM buDEH ॥” puM । sUryyavaMSIyanfpaBedaH । yaTA, harivaMSe 15 । 22 । “anaraRyasuto niGno niGnaputrO baBUvatuH ॥”)
v: tri॰ nihanyate ni + hana--GaYarTe ka । 1 aDIne amaraH । niyamyatvAt tasya taTAtvam “niGnasya me BarttfnideSarOkzyam” raGuH । 2 Ahate 3 pUrite ca “sTApyo'ntyavargo dviguRAntyaniGnaH” lIlA॰ “punardvAdaSaniGnAcca laBate yatPalaM buDEH” sUryasi॰ । sUryavaMSye 4 anaraRyasute nfpaBede pu॰ । “anaraRyasuto niGno niGnaputrO baBUvatuH” harivaM॰ 17 a॰ । anamitraputre 5 nfpaBede ca “anamitrasuto niGno niGnasya tu baBUvatuH” harivaM॰ 39 a॰ ।
m: नि-घ्न mf(आ)n. (√ हन्) dependent, subservient, docile, obedient
(ifc.) dependent on, ruled by, devoted to, full of Kāv. &c. (-ता f., Kathās.)
(after a numeral) multiplied with, Sūryas.
नि-घ्न m. N. of a son of An-araṇya and father of Anamitra, Hariv.
of a son of An-amitra, ib.
a: निघ्न — a. 1 Dependent, subservient, obedient (as a servant); तथापि निघ्नं नृप तावकीनैः प्रह्वीकृतं मे हृदयं गुणौघैः Ki. 3. 12; निघ्नस्य मे भर्तृनिदेशरौक्ष्यं देवि क्षमस्वेति बभूव नम्रः R. 14. 58. --2 Docile, tractable. --3 Dependent on (i. e. following the gender &c. of) a substantive; इति विशेष्यनिघ्नवर्गः. --4 (After a numeral) Multiplied by.

k.v: परतन्त्रः पराधीनः परवान्नाथवानपि। अधीनो निघ्न आयत्तोऽस्वच्छन्दो गृह्यकोऽप्यसौ॥

m: नि-˚घ्नक mfn. dependent, L.
नि-˚घ्नत्, नि-˚घ्नमान and नि-˚घ्नान, mfn. slaying, killing, MBh.; R. &c.
नि-घ्न—ता f., Kathās.
नि-√ 2. घुष् Caus. -घोषयति, to tread down, crush, destroy, RV.
